parameters.excerpt: It is expected that BootROM will set ``mseccfg.MMWP`` and/or ``mseccfg.MML`` during early boot, before jumping to the firmware, so that the firmware will be able to determine the presence of Smepmp by reading ``mseccfg`` and checking the state of ``mseccfg.MMWP`` and ``mseccfg.MML``.
parameters.reasoning: The specification expects but does not require that BootROM sets these fields for discovery. This is an implementation choice about how software discovery is facilitated, though the language is somewhat suggestive rather than definitively optional.
